question: What will be the percentage change in Amazon (AMZN) stock (AMZN on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-09-03 to the close on 2026-10-02?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-10-02 / close on 2026-09-03 - 1), using daily closes of AMZN on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-10-02, the last close before it is used.
research:
I've collected most of what I need, so here is the summary. Stock price pages on Yahoo and StockAnalysis refused my direct connections, so the price data below comes from search-result snippets. Anything published after 2026-09-04 has been left out.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on AMZN daily closes on Yahoo Finance. I could not load the Yahoo history page because the proxy refused the connection. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AMZN/history/)
- 2026-09-03: The baseline close was **$258.90**, up 1.54% on the day (open 256.20, high 259.50, low 256.00, volume about 26.9M). This is from a StockAnalysis snippet and implies a 2026-09-02 close of about $254.97. I could not cross-check it on Yahoo. [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/amzn/history/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The window runs from the 2026-09-03 close to the 2026-10-02 close, about 21 trading days.
- 2026-09-03: At $258.90 the stock was about 8.8% below its record close. [Macrotrends](https://www.macrotrends.net/stocks/charts/AMZN/amazon/stock-price-history)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-03: Wells Fargo (Ken Gawrelski) raised its price target from $328 to $338 and kept a Buy rating, citing expected AWS margin expansion. [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/AMZN), [Capital.com](https://capital.com/en-int/analysis/amazon-stock-forecast-is-it-a-buy)
- 2026-09-01: A secondary listing showed a close of $262.07, but it looks like thin trading, so I would not rely on it. I found no news explaining the moves on Sept 1-2. [StockAnalysis SNSE](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/snse/AMZN/history/)
- Late August 2026: The stock drifted down after its post-earnings peak. Closes were 265.84 on Aug 19, 262.07 on Aug 24, 261.06 on Aug 25 and 260.28 on Aug 26. [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/amzn/history/)
- 2026-08-03: The stock set its all-time closing high of **$284.02** (intraday high about $287.20). [Macrotrends](https://www.macrotrends.net/stocks/charts/AMZN/amazon/stock-price-history)
- 2026-07-30: Q2 results came out:
  - Revenue topped $200B for the first time.
  - AWS revenue grew 37% to $42.2B, against about 31% expected. That is its fastest growth in 18 quarters.
  - Reported cloud backlog was about $496B.
  - 2026 capex guidance was raised to about $220B.
  - Trailing 12-month free cash flow was about -$7.6B.
  - GAAP EPS was inflated by an Anthropic-related gain.
  - The stock jumped. Sources disagree on how much, from about 9-10% up to 15%. [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/petercohan/2026/07/31/amazon-stock-pops-108-on-aws-growth-payoff-from-ai-capex/), [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/amazon-reports-q2-2026-earnings-raises-full-year-capital-expenditure-to-220-billion), [INDmoney](https://www.indmoney.com/blog/us-stocks/amazon-q2-earnings-results-why-amzn-stock-jumped-analysis)

## 4. Base rates
- These are my own rough estimates, not taken from a source. AMZN's long-run annualized volatility is about 30-35%. That means a 21-trading-day move usually has a standard deviation of about 8-10%.
- Over 2023-2026, most one-month moves fell roughly between -10% and +12%. Moves beyond ±15% usually came with earnings, and none falls in this window.
- There is a historical drift of about +1% to +2% per month, on average.
- September has historically been a weak month for US stocks on average, though the effect is small and inconsistent.
- Recent trend: the stock fell about 9% from the Aug 3 peak to Sept 3, after a strong post-earnings gap up.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market that matches this window, such as "AMZN close on Oct 2". Polymarket has run daily and weekly AMZN price markets, for example "AMZN close above $255 on September 1, 2026", but these settle on Pyth prices, not Yahoo. [Struct](https://explorer.struct.to/markets/amzn-close-above-255-on-september-1-2026)
- 2026-09-03: Wells Fargo's $338 target is about 30% above the baseline close. Sell-side targets are mostly 12-month Buy-rated targets, which tells us little about a one-month move. [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/AMZN)
- One low-quality algorithmic site projected an end-of-September price of about $241. I would treat it as noise. [poundf](https://poundf.co.uk/amazon)

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-10-02
- 2026-09-04: The August jobs report is due. July payrolls had fallen by 23,000, unemployment was 4.1%, and May-June were revised down by a combined 103,000. [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/fed-rate-hike-uncertainty-grows-ahead-of-september-meeting/)
- Mid-September: The August CPI report is due. July CPI was 3.4% year on year.
- 2026-09-15/16: The FOMC meets, with the target range at 3.50-3.75%. July's meeting held rates steady on a 9-3 vote, with three members wanting a hike. Before the meeting, prediction markets priced about 65% for a hold and about 35% for a 25 bp hike. A hike would be the first since 2023. [Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/us/en/prediction-markets/economics/events/fed-rate-decision-in-september-2026-sep-16-2026/), [ATFX](https://www.atfx.com/en-au/analysis/financial-events/september-fomc-meeting-2026-is-a-rate-hike-on-the-table)
- Ongoing: News on AI capex across the megacaps, AWS product and partnership announcements, and analyst target changes could all move the stock.
- After the window: The Q3 earnings report is expected in late October, and the October Prime sale usually runs in early-to-mid October. Both likely fall after Oct 2, but previews and announcements before then could still matter.
